bibliographic_scope.title: Solution-Based Growth of Monodisperse Cube-Like BaTiO3 Colloidal Nanocrystals
bibliographic_scope.authors: Shiva Adireddy; Cuikun Lin; Baobao Cao; Weilie Zhou; Gabriel Caruntu

source_interpretation.text: Open-atmosphere mixing gives mixed cube-like populations and carbonate impurity; anaerobic glovebox mixing gives regular cubes. Both source treatments use 135 °C for18 h; the glovebox gas and hot pressure are unknown.

evidence.locator: SI PDF p. 2, Chemicals and synthesis of cube-like BaTiO3 nanoparticles

source_interpretation.text: Regular-cube shape does not uniquely establish a cubic polymorph. XRD uses a pseudocubic assumption while Raman indicates local tetragonal distortions; no measured atomic coordinates are supplied.

20 nm is the air-route regular-cube subset;22 nm is the inert-route average edge;21.3 nm is Scherrer size. The separate21.5 nm FTIR caption and4.09 Å HRTEM spacing retain their own sample qualifications.
The optical excitation-energy parentheticals and some SI instrument/range statements are inconsistent as printed. They are retained as qualified context, without guessed corrections.

method_yield.scope: Source method-level yield; no separate atmosphere yield or calculation basis supplied.

evidence.locator: SI PDF p. 2, Chemicals and synthesis of cube-like BaTiO3 nanoparticles

characterization_protocol.TEM: JEOL2010,200kV; exact grid preparation not supplied.
characterization_protocol.EDX: JEOL2010; SI incorrectly labels parenthetical EXAFS. FigureS4 has Ba/Ti/O and C/Cu peaks; no quantitative atomic ratios reported.
characterization_protocol.XRD: Panalytical X’Pert,CuKα λ1.54056Å,40kV40mA,room temperature,15°≤2θ≤75°. Figure2a(200)slow scan step0.002°,speed0.00025°/s.
characterization_protocol.PL: Room temperature,Perkin-ElmerLS55,275nm,450WXe arc; step0.02°/20s per step is printed in the same sentence and technique assignment remains unresolved. Figure3 excitationseries differs.
characterization_protocol.FTIR: ThermoNicoletOmnic,ATR; printed500–400cm−1 conflicts with plottedFigureS5 range.

reference_bulk_values.scope: Cited bulk reference values, not measurements of these nanocrystals.

FTIR_label_inventory.scope: Labels printed directly on FigureS5 curves; no new peak assignment or digitized intensities.

morphology_population.scope: Different populations in one air preparation; not additional synthetic samples.

mechanism.growth: Authors propose low-index{100}faces lower surface energy; theoretical and cited background not measured surface-energy data.
mechanism.PL: Localized states from local Ti4+ off-center shifts; FigureS7 conceptual process, not measured atomic model.
mechanism.EPR: No detected O/Ti defects associated with unpaired electrons; detection limit absent.
mechanism.ongoing: Neutron and piezoelectric-force microscopy investigations described as ongoing, not delivered evidence.

SI_identity: Same title and five authors/affiliation; SI orders BaobaoCao before CuikunLin while main reverses these two. Publisher-linked existing SI read fully.

references.note: All28 numbered main bibliography entries read; cited full papers unreviewed.

limitations: Complete three-page main and matched ten-page SI, all three main and seven SI figures and 28 numbered main references. Cited full sources unreviewed.

Addition order and rate among the four solutions, mixing time, temperature ramp, hot pressure, centrifuge speed/time, purification details and toluene volume are not reported. Natural cooling to room temperature is explicit.
Open-atmosphere and anaerobic glovebox solution preparation are separate source routes; the glovebox atmosphere identity is unknown. SI explicitly assigns the same hydrothermal treatment to both.
Acetic-acid wash is a separate post-treatment of carbonate-containing powder: 5% is printed without basis, wash volume/time or independently reported final particle size.
Yield 85–90% is reported for the method without atmosphere-specific allocation. No size selection was performed.

The 20 nm TEM value describes only the 36% regular-cube subset of air-prepared particles. The approximately 58% cube-like and 6% truncated populations are distinct observations, not three new preparations.

HRTEM Figure S2, FTIR Figure S5 (caption 21.5 nm), TGA/DSC and optical curves are not given an exact physical-batch crosswalk. Their support records do not inherit all direct-route conditions or produce extra pairs.
No measured atomic coordinates are supplied. Pseudocubic cell indexing and interpreted local distortions are not a measured atomic model; neutron/PFM investigations are described as ongoing.
Independent source comparison passed; molecular/particle/reference-cell presentation remains pending.
evidence_conflicts: Main p.3 pairs excitation 390 nm with 2.43 eV and 510 nm with printed 3.18 nm. Wavelengths are retained; the inconsistent energy/unit parentheticals are not corrected or used as energy measurements.

SI p.2 calls energy-dispersive X-ray spectroscopy EXAFS and prints FTIR range 500 to 400 cm−1; Figure S5 spans a broader plotted range. The printed technique/range mismatch is retained, not silently repaired.
SI p.3 places step 0.02° and 20 s per step in its PL sentence; their technique assignment is unresolved. Figure 2a separately gives the XRD slow-scan settings.

Main p.2 assumes pseudocubic indexing because cubic and tetragonal polymorphs cannot be resolved by these XRD data; Raman supports local tetragonal distortions. Cubic particle morphology does not establish a uniquely refined cubic phase.
